package.name: Workshop Make
package.description: Getting a part made: setups (print, cut, mill) and the limits a part must meet, a printability check and a pass/fix verdict, mass as printed and ballast, fits and hardware holes sized for your printer, screw threads from the standards, parts encased mid-print with the pauses to drop them in, slicing (PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio), printers on the network, sheet parts laid out as DXF/SVG, milled parts as STEP with a setup sheet, and frames by beam elements. Its own workbench (Workshop Make) with task panels and a panel of Setups, Materials and Fits tabs; a Python API (workshop_make.api); tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: Workshop Make
workbench.description: Setups, printability and review, fits and hardware, threads, slicing and output for print, cut and mill.
